hero.headline: I build interfaces people enjoy using — now with AI inside.
hero.lead: Fifteen years in tech across QA, team leadership and frontend development. I bring a tester's eye and a designer's training to React products, and lately I ship them with generative AI built in.
hero.artAlt: Portrait of Rebecca Souza, cut into overlapping colored diamonds

about.title: From breaking software to building it.

paragraphs.p1: I started in tech in 2011 as a QA analyst at PSafe, while studying Industrial Design. Six years of finding out how software breaks taught me to care about how it should feel.
paragraphs.p2: In 2017 I moved to frontend development and spent two years building React tools at PSafe. Then came leadership: I led frontend teams and projects at PSafe, CyberLabs, Mercado Livre and Safra International Bank (via Foursys).
paragraphs.p3: In 2025 I went back to writing code full time, building Vue.js interfaces at Lifemed. I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science (2024) and completed eight semesters of Industrial Design, which still shapes how I think about layout, form and detail.

projects.title: Recent work, with AI in the loop.
